<script type="text/javascript">
var loopRound = "1";
$(document).ready(function(){
var winWidth = $(window).width();   
if (winWidth >= 768){
	var myTrue = false;
	}else{
	var myTrue = true; 
    }
	var trandingLazy = (selector, oldIndex, newIndex) =>{
			$img = $(selector+' img:eq(' + (newIndex) + ')');
			if ($img.attr('original-src')) {
				$img.attr('src', $img.attr('original-src'));
				$img.removeAttr('original-src');
			}
	}
	$(document).on('click','.eodRhsBody .bx-next,.eodRhsBody .bx-prev',function(){
			$(this).addClass('pointer');
			setTimeout(function() {
				$('.eodRhsBody .bx-next,.eodRhsBody .bx-prev').removeClass('pointer');
			}, 500);
	});
	$('.trending_slider').bxSlider({
        auto:true,responsive:true,moveSlides:1,pager:true,
		adaptiveHeight: true,
		infiniteLoop: loopRound,
		hideControlOnEnd:true,
        pager:false,
		autoHover:true,
		stopAutoOnClick : true,
		adaptiveHeight : true,
		touchEnabled:myTrue,
		onSliderLoad: function () {
             $('.trending_slider > li').eq(1).addClass('active-slide');
			 var activeHref = $('.active-slide a').attr('href');
			$('#changeOnload').attr('href',activeHref)
        },
		onSlideBefore: function($slideElement, oldIndex, newIndex){
			var _ele = $slideElement.find('img');
			if ( _ele.attr('original-src') ) {
				_ele.attr('src', _ele.attr('original-src'));
				_ele.removeAttr('original-src');
				}
			},
		 onSlideAfter: function (currentSlideNumber, totalSlideQty, currentSlideHtmlObject) {
            $('.active-slide').removeClass('active-slide');
            $('.trending_slider > li').eq(currentSlideHtmlObject + 1).addClass('active-slide')
			var activeHref = $('.active-slide a').attr('href');
			$('#changeOnload').attr('href',activeHref)
        },
		
	});

})
</script>
